name: Eldredgeops
provenance: Middle Devonian, Givetian Hamilton Group, northeastern North America
description: Rounded, tuberculate phacopid trilobite with seventeen-file schizochroal compound eyes, eleven articulated thoracic tergites and a ribbed pygidium. Ventral biramous limbs and antennae are comparative soft-part reconstruction.
refinementNeeded: Exact enrollment coaptation remains incomplete; the rolling animation is a defensive flexion preview, not a verified closed enrolled shell.
Extended action playback and detailed appendage collision refinement are deferred under the preview-first production priority.
notes: Shell uses E. rana sensu Eldredge1972, not E. milleri or spiny Moroccan phacopids.
Three cephalic post-antennal pairs, eleven thoracic pairs and four pygidial pairs are a comparative reconstruction; exact E. rana appendage anatomy and living pigmentation are uncertain.
Individual calcite lens solids are seated in continuous anatomical ocular platforms. Eye volume reports test each lens, not only aggregate eye volume.

All rigid shells move by joints. Growth is an unscaled compatibility posture; Moult is a separate preparation/withdrawal gesture. Swim is a plausible limb-powered compatibility action, not a claim of habitual pelagic swimming.
Representative 6cm shell length is illustrative, not a species maximum. Antennae extend the exported bounds.
